You all know each other's faith and what each of you eats: Natalie Rodrigues is Catholic, Jun Jie is Buddhist, Suresh is Hindu and does not eat beef, and Mei Ling is Muslim and eats halal. It is a weeknight and all four are in the living room. All four will be living here together for the rest of the lease.
scenario.shared_trigger: Natalie Rodrigues has just come home with two cartons of beer and three bottles of wine for Saturday, bought with Natalie Rodrigues's own money, and has put them in the fridge. Natalie Rodrigues has said the drinks are sorted. Mei Ling is looking at them. Jun Jie and Suresh are in the living room too. Nobody has said anything else yet.
